tools.name: school_card
tools.description: Show one college as a card: photo or campus map, overall admit rate and admit rate by round (Early Decision, Early Action, Regular Decision) with deadlines, SAT/ACT middle 50%, testing policy, sticker cost, average net price, graduation rate, biggest majors, and a link to its prefrosh.ai page. Use f

tools.name: my_odds
tools.description: Estimate a student's admission odds at one or more colleges, by round, with a likely range, from GPA and test scores (plus optional class rank, home state, legacy, first-generation, aid). Same model as prefrosh.ai/chance. Always tell the user this is an estimate from grades and scores only; essays,

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 colleges side by side: admit rates by round, SAT/ACT ranges, testing policy, sticker cost, average net price, graduation rate, size and setting. If GPA or scores are given, adds the student's estimated odds (same model as prefrosh.ai/chance).

tools.name: admissions_game
tools.description: Run the student's application past prefrosh.ai's simulated admissions committee for one college and round: five fictional readers (first, second, essay and faculty readers, and a dean who chairs) read it, argue, vote (accept / waitlist or defer / deny), and give the top 3 fixes. It is a simulation,

tools.name: game_read
tools.description: App-only. One reader of the admissions game reads the file.

tools.name: game_vote
tools.description: App-only. The committee meets and votes.

tools.name: game_debrief
tools.description: App-only. The chair writes the debrief.

tools.name: game_done
tools.description: App-only. Records that a run finished (counts only).

description: App-only stage of admissions_game, called by the in-chat view after the vote. The committee chair writes the debrief: the three changes that would most help this application, each pointing to the student's own words. Simulation only; it never writes or rewrites essays.

labels.name: game_done
labels.description: App-only. Called by the in-chat view when an admissions_game run ends, to record that it finished (school, AI token use and duration only; no application text). Returns nothing the user sees.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "game_read" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "App-only. One reader of the admissions game reads the file." → after: "App-only stage of admissions_game, called by the in-chat view, not by the model. One fictional admissions reader (the kind given) reads the student's application for this school and round and returns short notes: what works, what gave them pause, one fix, and the lines they marked. Simulation only; "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
